block_hash.description: Hash of the confirming block, hex.

confirmations.description: Confirmations when the evidence was accepted (`tip − block_height + 1`).

outputs.description: Outputs of the transaction that pay the destination address.

required_confirmations.description: Confirmations the chain profile required for this settlement's USD value (`confirmation_tiers`; 1 for every amount by default, ADR-0022 as amended).

Evidence.description: Independent on-chain proof that a settlement reached the merchant (INV-2).

amount.description: Amount received by the recipient, base units.

bitcoin.description: Bitcoin detail (txid, outputs, confirmations) when `chain` is Bitcoin; null/absent otherwise. Spec 0.4.0.

block_ref.description: Block height or hash containing the transaction.

finality.description: Finality reached when the evidence was accepted: `final` (NEAR), `confirmed` (one block of the chain's own consensus: EVM 1 block, Solana `confirmed` commitment, Bitcoin 1 confirmation — the default, ADR-0022 as amended), `finalized` (a chain's finalized tag/commitment, when configured).

recipient.description: Recipient that received the funds (the merchant destination).

anyOf.description: Address in the chain's canonical text form.

sender.description: Account that sent the settlement transfer, when the detector saw it (NEAR Intents: the transferring Intents account); null if unknown. Spec 0.3.0.

solana.description: Solana detail (signature, slot, mint, token-balance delta) when `chain` is Solana; null/absent otherwise. Spec 0.4.0.

tier.description: Verification tier: A = independently verified on chain, B = provider-attested within limits.

tx_hash.description: Settlement transaction (NEAR receipt / tx hash for Intents).

Execution.description: A provider run moving value for a payment (rails owns).

abandon_reason.description: Reason payments gave when abandoning the leg.

abandoned_at.description: When payments abandoned this refund leg (`abandonExecution`); it is then `expired_unpaid` and only tracked for late money (INV-3).

items.description: Transaction hash in the chain's text form.

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).

deposited_amount.description: What the payer actually deposited, base units of `origin.asset_id` (provider `depositedAmount`, or the executed Intents transfer incl. fee); null until a deposit is detected. Lets checkout and the dashboard show “received X of Y” for an incomplete deposit.

anyOf.description: Why held.

kind.description: What the execution moves value for.

method.description: `route_quote`: deposit to a 1Click address from any chain. `intents_transfer`: signed transfer from a NEAR Intents balance.

observed_fee.description: NearPay fee observed for this execution (reconciliation fee check): the app fee the provider reports for a route, or the fee transfer of an executed Intents payload; null until known or when the provider reports none (refund legs carry no app fee: null).

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset (display of base units; spec 0.2.1, absent from older rails).

owner.description: Service that consumes this execution's events and owns its merchant record (spec 0.3.0; absent = `payments`). Consumers ignore executions they do not own.

reference.description: Payments object served (from the create request); null for executions created before Stage 2.

refund.description: Refund legs: `origin` is the merchant side (asset, chain, `refund_to` = the merchant destination) and `settlement` the payer side (`recipient` = the payer's refund address, `tag` 0).

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).
Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset (display of base units; spec 0.2.1, absent from older rails).

state.description: Attempt status (mirrors the rails execution, domain-model §4.3).

terminal_at.description: When it reached a terminal state.

version.description: Increments with every applied change (consumers ignore stale versions).

anyOf.description: Binding memo `np1:` + base58(sha256(…)) tying a signed transfer to one requirement.

x402_binding.description: Owner `agentpay`: binding of the `near-intents` requirement the quote was minted for; null otherwise.

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).

fee_amount_in.description: Part of `amount_in` that pays NearPay's fee, base units of the origin asset (display only): `0` when the merchant bears the fee, null when rails cannot apportion it. Absent from rails before 0.2.1.

ExecutionReference.description: The payments object an execution belongs to.

anyOf.description: payment_attempt id (`pa_` + 26 base32 chars).
refund id (`re_` + 26 base32 chars).

ExecutionRefund.description: Refund-leg details of an execution (`kind: refund`).

amount.description: What the merchant sends, base units of the source (settlement) asset.

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).

amount_out_expected.description: What the payer should receive, base units of the recipient asset (quote `amountOut`).

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).
Route quote type.

token.description: How to transfer the source asset on its chain (`sign_and_send` legs); null for Intents sources.

transfer.description: Set when the source is an Intents account: the transfer to sign (to the payer, or to the 1Click deposit address).

IntentsRequirement.description: What a payer must sign: transfer(pay_to, amount) and transfer(fee_to, fee_amount), both with memo = binding.

amount.description: Amount the merchant receives, base units.

binding.description: Memo that both transfers must carry.

fee_amount.description: NearPay fee, base units, in the same asset.

pay_to.description: Merchant Intents account that receives the payment.

token.description: Asset to transfer (equals the settlement asset).

ObservedFee.description: NearPay fee as observed for an execution (provider-reported app fee or the executed Intents fee transfer).

asset_id.description: Asset the fee was taken in.

PriceRate.description: A price or FX rate with its source and timestamps (INV-5: exact rational).

as_of.description: When the source says the value applies (ECB: publication time of the reference day; feeds: their update time).

anyOf.description: ISO 4217 currency code, lower-case (e.g. `usd`).
NEAR Intents asset id, e.g. `nep141:17208628f84f5d6ad33f0da3bbbeb27ffcb398eac501a31bd6ad2011e36133a1`.

base.description: What is priced: a currency code or an asset id.

decimal.description: The rate as a decimal string rounded half-even to ≤ 18 places; display only, never for arithmetic.

quote.description: Currency the value is expressed in (`usd`).

role.description: `primary`/`secondary`: the two token prices the dual-source check compares (rails §8.2); `reference`: a fiat FX reference rate.

source.description: Where a rate comes from: `oneclick` (1Click `/v0/tokens`, primary token price), `coingecko` (keyless public feed, secondary token price), `ecb` (ECB euro reference rates, fiat FX), `sandbox` (test-mode token prices), `fixed` (test-mode FX table, and `usd`→`usd`).

valid_until.description: After this instant rails no longer uses the rate (staleness bound, rails §8.2); null = no bound (`fixed`).

value.description: Quote major units per one major unit of `base`.

PriceSnapshot.description: Prices used to compute the settlement amount (INV-6).

anyOf.description: ISO 4217 currency code, lower-case (e.g. `usd`).

currency.description: Pricing currency of the payment (spec 0.2.0; rails 0.2.0+ always sends it): an ISO code, or `asset`.

fx.description: FX rate pricing currency → USD (decimal string), null for USD.

par.description: Settled at par (USD stablecoin, depeg guard passed).

anyOf.description: ISO 4217 currency code, lower-case (e.g. `usd`).

par_currency.description: Currency the settlement asset was taken at par with (`usd` for USD stablecoins), or null (spec 0.2.0).

primary_usd.description: Primary USD price of the settlement asset (decimal string).

rates.description: Every rate used, exact, with source, `as_of` and `valid_until` (spec 0.2.0; rails 0.2.0+ always sends it): the FX rate of a non-USD currency and the primary + secondary prices of a non-par asset.

Ratio.description: An exact rational number `num / den` (integer strings, never a float).

RefundTransfer.description: What a merchant signs for a refund leg from an Intents account: exactly one transfer, memo = binding.

memo.description: Binding memo the transfer must carry (agentpay matches it; the indexer attributes by it).

anyOf.description: 32-byte nonce (4-byte Verifier salt ‖ 28 random bytes), standard base64.

nonce.description: Nonce to sign with (current Verifier salt ‖ 28 random bytes), issued by rails when it prepares the leg; payments copies it into `next_action` unchanged. Absent from rails before 0.2.1 (payments then derives it from the salt itself).

receiver_id.description: Payer Intents account (`intents_transfer` leg) or the 1Click INTENTS deposit address (`route_quote` leg).

signer_id.description: Merchant Intents account (the settlement destination) that signs.

block_time.description: Block time, unix seconds; null when the node has none.

anyOf.description: Solana address: base58 of 32 bytes (ed25519 public key or program-derived address).

mint.description: SPL mint that settled; null for native SOL (lamports).

owner.description: Wallet whose balance rose (= `Evidence.recipient`, the merchant destination).

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).

post_amount.description: Owner's balance of the mint after the transaction; null when the detector did not read balances (test mode).

anyOf.description: Asset amount in base units as a decimal string (no sign, no decimals, ≤ 78 digits).

pre_amount.description: Owner's balance of the mint before the transaction (`meta.preTokenBalances` / `preBalances`); null when the detector did not read balances (test mode).

slot.description: Slot of the block that contains the transaction (= `Evidence.block_ref`).

token_accounts.description: Token accounts of `owner` for `mint` whose balance changed (usually its ATA); empty for SOL.

items.description: Solana address: base58 of 32 bytes (ed25519 public key or program-derived address).

anyOf.description: Solana address: base58 of 32 bytes (ed25519 public key or program-derived address).

token_program.description: Owner program of the mint (`TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA` in v1); null for SOL.

TokenContract.description: How to transfer an asset on its chain (wallet path).

address.description: Contract address (EVM `0x…`), token account (NEAR) or SPL mint (Solana, base58; spec 0.4.0 wallet path); null for `native`.

standard.description: `erc20`: ERC-20 contract on an EVM chain; `native`: the chain's native coin (no contract); `nep141`: NEP-141 token on NEAR; `spl`: SPL mint on Solana; `other`: no wallet transfer recipe (manual path).

anyOf.description: UUID (RFC 9562).

account_id.description: Merchant account UUID (null for platform events).

id.description: Event id (UUIDv7); also the NATS `Nats-Msg-Id` for de-duplication.

anyOf.description: Request id, also returned in the `X-Request-Id` header.

id.description: API request that caused the change.
